breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the erroneous instruction: 'Use a single internal torque equal to the algebraic sum of applied torques over the full length for both stress and twist calculations.' The ground truth removes this incorrect directive entirely, since an intermediate applied torque at x = 800 mm makes the internal torque piecewise constant (different in each segment), not a single uniform value. The agent failed to eliminate this inconsistency and instead preserved the flawed instruction verbatim.
